candidates.title: The Seed Swap With Missing Names
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered gardeners brought home seed packets belonging to entirely different families during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they sorted the packets by color but the owners were still mismatched; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the registration team had switched the detachable claim slips between neighboring trays; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they matched signed receipts to tray numbers and returned each packet to its owner, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Picnic Cakes That Tasted of Salt
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered every cake baked for the picnic tasted salty despite following the recipe during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they added extra honey but the next cake tasted even worse; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized two identical unmarked tins held salt and sugar on the same shelf; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they tested and labeled the ingredients before making a fresh small batch, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Books Returned Before They Were Borrowed
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the library kiosk printed return times earlier than the books' checkout times during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they replaced the printer ribbon but every receipt showed the same contradiction; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the kiosk used a different time zone from the library's checkout register; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they synchronized both systems and corrected the affected borrowing records, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
